items.title: Java Locks & Synchronization
items.description: Deep dive into Java locks and synchronization primitives — synchronized, volatile, ReentrantLock, ReadWriteLock, StampedLock, AQS, CountDownLatch, CyclicBarrier, Semaphore, Exchanger, and Phaser.

items.title: Synchronization & Deadlocks
items.description: Race conditions, critical sections, mutexes, semaphores, monitors, classic synchronization problems, deadlock detection/prevention, and Java concurrency utilities.
